DriverNotes.Text: The camera vehicle was keeping pace with the traffic around it.
It began slowing 2.5 s before impact.
The camera vehicle was speeding up in the seconds before the collision.
The camera doesn't show the inside of the cab, so phone use or other distraction can only be judged from how the vehicle moved.

Narrative: At 0:10.4 the video shows an impact from outside the camera's view, at the camera vehicle, from outside the camera's view (the side or rear). Involved: the camera vehicle. 18 other road users were in view but not involved. Fault looks shared: the camera vehicle 50%, the other vehicle (not visible) 50%. Nothing in the camera vehicle's own driving stood out as a cause.
